title: Code of Practice: 3rd Draft
summary: This document is the third draft of a “Code of Practice,” outlining recommended standards and procedures for responsible AI development, deployment, and governance. title: AI Pact Draft
summary: The AI Pact Draft is a proposed agreement that outlines shared responsibilities for developing and deploying artificial intelligence, focusing on safety, transparency, and ethical use. It seeks to encourage collaboration among governments, industry, and civil society to ensure AI benefits society while mitigating risks.

title: AI Pact Final
summary: The AI Pact Final outlines a comprehensive framework for the responsible development and deployment of artificial intelligence, emphasizing transparency, accountability, and the protection of human rights. It establishes collaborative standards for governments, industry, and civil society to ensure AI systems are safe, fair, and aligned with societal values.

title: Guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices
